citations.claim: first violation: body 0 overlaps wall 0 by 0.1526 beyond 0.15 limit
one step before, body 0 still outside wall by 0.014
body 0 speed ~58 m/s at violation driving tunneling

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.004518 to 0.001 with same steps (13) to give finer substep resolution and prevent wall tunneling.

explanation: At step 12 body 0 is 0.014 outside wall 0 moving at ~58 m/s (vx 28.1, vy -50.8). Even with 9 substeps the discrete collision/positional-correction cannot resolve the fast approach and inter-body momentum exchange before penetration. At step 13 distance_to_surface becomes -0.1526 (overlap 0.1526 > 0.15 limit), violating no_wall_penetration. Reducing dt (finer integration) removes the tunneling while keeping all else identical.
vision_note: Across steps 10-12 the small red body moves toward the right end of the horizontal grey wall while the blue body hovers above. At step 13 the red body visibly clips into the corner/tip of the wall instead of remaining clear, showing an overlap penetration.
